limitations: No raw user text, assistant text or tool args are emitted.
Injection facts exist only in daily event logs; 2026-10-30 candidates have injectionObservable=false.

classificationRules.T: actual decision at the time where principled intervention was possible (SPEC v0.6 6.1); delivering a chat conclusion or artifact counts, a heartbeat with no deliverable does not
classificationRules.V: a qualified prior signal obtainable before the action
classificationRules.O: PD actually identified the opportunity before action (SPEC v0.6 6.1). An injection event is an assembly/return fact only: fair-rotation selection, prompt assembly, and opportunity identification are distinct events. A native-path injection event does NOT prove identification, because the native path has no opportunity-detection records at all. O stays unknown unless an identification record exists with entry point, prior signal, opportunity identity and timing (activationIds membership alone is not evidence).
classificationRules.D: independent confirmation that target body entered the actual request and preceded the key action; unknown unless body or equivalent independent evidence exists
classificationRules.tUnknown: recorded as unknown, never forced into include/exclude
classificationRules.keyAction: artifact_edit / verification_action / delivery_claim are distinct; first file write is not the cutoff for the verify-before-delivery principle
classificationRules.identity: session_id + transcript seq (existing verifiable row identity); body sha256 validates content only and never merges duplicate requests
